annotations.title: Notify when a formula crosses a value

description: Get notified when a saved live formula crosses a value you set. It is evaluated server-side every interval, whether or not anything is connected. direction: above (goes from at or below the threshold to above it), below (the reverse), or cross (either). After it fires it waits until the value is back on the other side by at least hysteresis and cooldownSeconds (60 to 86400, default 900) have passed. If the condition is already true when created, it starts disarmed and arms once the value is back across. It never fires on null or on a WARMING or stale value. Email goes to the account's verified address (default on); webhookUrl (https) optionally receives a signed POST. The response carries webhookSecret ONCE: store it to verify the x-blackforge-signature header (t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of t.body>). Live formulas and notifications are part of the Ultra plan.

email.description: Email the account's verified address. Default true.

hysteresis.description: How far back across it must go to re-arm. Default 0.

threshold.description: The value your formula must cross.

webhookUrl.description: Optional https URL that receives a signed JSON POST.
